messages:
Nora - Partnerships: Quick kickoff  we're running a 2-day SI mini-bootcamp for 6 partners. Need a slimmed-down onboarding kit + checklist. Can we sketch must-haves?
Ethan - SI Programs: Must-haves: sandbox credentials, 3 lab exercises (deploy, scale, observability), 1-page failure playbook. Keep it under 90 minutes per exercise.
Sofia - Enablement: I'll author the 1-page failure playbook and a 10-slide trainer deck. Ask: do we have canonical prompts/examples to include?
Liam - Field Eng: For labs: I'll create tenant templates with seeded model assets and a preconfigured dashboard. Also a small harness to replay demo user traffic.
Zoe - Marketing: We should make a short "how it looks" gif for partner outreach and a one-pager with outcomes (time to deploy, key metrics). Need 2 screenshots.
Nora - Partnerships: Decision: keep the kit minimal — partners get the fast-track badge if they finish all labs in the bootcamp. Criteria: successful E2E deploy + passing quick quiz (80%).
Ethan - SI Programs: Quiz size: 12 MCQs + 2 scenario questions. I'll draft and post the quiz tomorrow. Also propose pairing each partner with a trainer during labs.
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Prepare SI bootcamp assets" in 72h (3337846089).
Sofia - Enablement: Trainer pairing sounds good. I'll also prepare a trainer cheat-sheet with common issues and suggested prompts to debug.
Liam - Field Eng: Ops checklist (short):
```
- provision tenants (6)
- seed API keys + quotas
- upload demo dataset v2
- run smoke (model load <20s)
- record fallback demo video
```
Zoe - Marketing: I'll draft the gif & one-pager. Can someone drop two clean screenshots in /partnerships/assets/screenshots/bootcamp/ ?
Nora - Partnerships: Action owners: Ethan=quiz + trainer pairing, Sofia=trainer deck + failure playbook, Liam=tenant templates + harness, Zoe=marketing assets, Nora=coordination & invites. Aim: bootcamp dry-run in 6 business days.
Ethan - SI Programs: I'll also add a short partner survey at the end to capture friction points.
Sofia - Enablement: If translations are needed later, we ship EN first and localize top 2 languages post-run.
Nora - Partnerships: Perfect. Flag blockers here. We'll keep this thread as the tracker. :calendar:
